description: Unit: helper trims whitespace and dedupes case-insensitively within cc, preserving first display casing
Unit: address present in both cc and bcc is kept in cc only
Unit: invalid address throws validation error naming the field and value
Unit: 21 combined recipients rejected; 20 accepted
Unit: non-empty cc/bcc with isInternal=true throws; empty arrays with isInternal=true are accepted
Unit: undefined/empty cc and bcc return null (no metadata key written)

Integration: address matching a contact (primary or additional email) resolves contact_id and name; matching internal user resolves user_id; unknown stays email-only; lookups are tenant-scoped (other tenant's contact not matched)
Integration: TicketModel.createComment persists email_recipients merged with existing metadata (e.g. closes_ticket preserved)

Integration: addTicketCommentWithCache with cc/bcc stores normalized email_recipients on the comment — DEFERRED: no harness for invoking a Next.js server action (session + RBAC + revalidatePath) against a database; the normalization and storage are covered by T007/T008 and by the REST path T015-T019, which call the same helper and model

Integration: addTicketCommentWithCache rejects cc on an internal comment and creates no comment — DEFERRED: same harness gap as T009; the internal-note rejection is covered at the helper (T005) and REST (T017) layers

Integration: createComment with parent_comment_id and cc stores email_recipients on the reply — DEFERRED: same harness gap as T009; the reply path is covered by the composer wiring (T058/T066) and by the threaded-reply delivery (T072)
Integration: addTicketComment forwards cc/bcc — DEFERRED: same harness gap as T009
Integration: bundle master comment with cc mirrors to child without email_recipients

Integration: scheduled comment with cc keeps email_recipients through publishScheduledCommentHandler and delivery uses them — DEFERRED: needs the scheduled-publication job runner; the row-not-payload read it depends on is covered by T023 and by every isolated-SMTP case, whose fixtures never put recipients in the payload
API: POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/comments with cc/bcc returns 201 and email_recipients in response
API: invalid email in cc returns 400 with field error
API: cc with is_internal=true returns 400
API: request without cc/bcc behaves as before (backward compatible)
API: GET ticket comments includes email_recipients for comments that have them
Generated OpenAPI spec contains cc/bcc on TicketCommentCreateBody and the MCP registry entry reflects it
Unit: sendEventEmail forwards cc/bcc to TenantEmailService.sendEmail and omits them when absent
Subscriber: public agent comment with cc/bcc sends requester email with matching cc and bcc arrays
Subscriber: email_recipients read from the comment row even when event payload lacks them (recovery republish)
Subscriber: ticket with no requester email + cc → one message To=cc list, Bcc=bcc list
Subscriber: suppressContactNotifications=true + cc → requester not emailed, cc fallback message sent
Subscriber: no requester email and bcc-only → one separate message per bcc address, none exposing other bcc addresses
Subscriber: contact notifications disabled by tenant settings + cc -> no email at all (decision: the tenant kill switch wins over an explicit Cc; the fallback runs and hits the same gate)
Subscriber: watcher who is also cc'd gets exactly one email (the combined one)
Subscriber: assigned user who is also bcc'd gets exactly one email
Subscriber: requester address included in cc is dropped from cc (not duplicated in To and Cc)
Subscriber: internal comment row carrying email_recipients (forced via DB) sends no cc/bcc

Subscriber: combined send with comment attachments delivers attachments in the single message and writes one delivery claim keyed on To — DEFERRED: needs stored comment attachments (documents + storage provider) in the isolated-SMTP harness; the claim and attachment gate keying on To only is covered by T020
Email log row for the combined send has cc_addresses and bcc_addresses populated and is visible in TicketEmailNotifications
Combined message includes the reply token marker and In-Reply-To/References headers; Message-ID appended to email_metadata.references once
Regression: comment without email_recipients produces the same recipient set and send count as before
Subscriber: next public comment on same ticket (no cc) does not email previously cc'd addresses
Integration: getTicketOneOffRecipients returns union across comments, lower-cased, scoped by tenant and ticket
Inbound: token-matched reply from cc'd external address creates a comment and does not add sender to watch list
Inbound: requester reply-all with cc'd addresses in Cc creates a comment and adds none of them to watch list
Inbound: reply-all that also includes a never-cc'd new address still adds that new address as inbound_cc watcher (existing behaviour preserved)
Inbound: thread-header-only reply (token stripped) from a cc'd address is accepted, not quarantined
Inbound: thread-header-only reply from an address never cc'd on that ticket is still quarantined (and an address cc'd on a different ticket doesn't count)
Workflow: tickets.add_comment with cc and is_internal=true fails validation
Workflow: tickets.add_comment with cc stores email_recipients and hands createComment the publisher that emits TICKET_COMMENT_ADDED; an author-less workflow comment's cc is still delivered
Workflow regression: tickets.add_comment without cc/bcc emits no event and sends no email
Workflow designer: cc/bcc inputs accept a literal list and an expression resolving to an array of emails
Component: typing an address + Enter creates a chip; comma/semicolon paste splits into multiple chips
Component: invalid address renders an error chip; Backspace on empty input removes last chip; x removes a chip
Component: suggestions list ticket client contacts before internal users; a pointer press picks one and stores contact_id/user_id, and leaving the field with a half-typed query raises no error chip
TextEditor renders footer-actions slot next to Attach files; omitted slot leaves layout unchanged
UI: Cc/Bcc toggle appears next to Attach files on a public reply and expands both rows
UI: collapsed toggle shows recipient count badge
UI: switching Internal on hides Cc/Bcc and shows note; switching off restores entered values; sending as internal sends no cc/bcc
UI: invalid chip disables Send with inline error
UI→action: sending a reply with cc/bcc calls addTicketCommentWithCache with them (container path) and createComment fallback path
UI: after successful send the next draft has empty Cc/Bcc; after failed send recipients remain

UI: scheduling a comment with cc stores email_recipients on the scheduled comment — DEFERRED: scheduling runs through the server action and job path of T014; the composer half, cc riding the schedule call, is covered by T055/T068
UI: inline threaded reply to a public comment with cc calls createComment with parent_comment_id and cc; email_recipients stored on the reply
UI: reply from the CommentThreadDrawer with cc/bcc forwards them the same way as the inline reply
UI: reply composer under an internal comment shows no Cc/Bcc control
UI: bento layout composer shows Cc/Bcc next to Attach files and sends cc/bcc via onAddNewComment

UI: bento layout inline reply sends cc/bcc via onAddReplyComment — DEFERRED: the bento inline reply needs the thread-group rendering stack this suite stubs out; it reuses the control and InlineReplyComposer slot pinned by T058/T066/T071, and the bento composer's own path is covered by T068
UI: client portal ticket composer and reply composer render no Cc/Bcc control
Component: InlineReplyComposer without the slot renders unchanged and its onSubmit payload is backward compatible (existing replyComposer e2e contract test still passes)
UI: Cc and Bcc entered in the Resolve and close dialog reach onConfirm as the cc/bcc payload
UI: an internal resolution hides the rows and sends no recipients, keeping the entered values
UI: an invalid address disables Resolve and close until it is corrected
UI: reopening the Resolve and close dialog clears the previous recipients, and a host that opts out gets no control at all
Subscriber: a threaded reply (parent_comment_id set) with cc sends the requester email with Cc, same as a top-level comment
SMTP: the requester's close email carries Cc from the closing resolution, the Bcc copy names nobody, and the log records both lists
SMTP: with no requester address the close message goes To the first Cc with the rest in Cc and Bcc
SMTP: a resolution that did not close the ticket keeps its Cc off a later close email
SMTP: a watcher also cc'd on the closing resolution receives exactly one close message
UI: MSP timeline shows Cc and Bcc lines with contact names when known and raw emails otherwise
Client portal action response for ticket comments contains cc but never bcc
UI: client portal timeline shows Cc line and no Bcc line
Mobile unit: addTicketComment includes cc/bcc in POST body only when non-empty
Mobile: Cc/Bcc section hidden when internal toggle on; draft resets after send
Mobile: comment with email_recipients renders Cc/Bcc lines
i18n key-parity check passes for all locales with new cc/bcc keys
